result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now collects only active contributors. I ran the module's `Landscape*` tests and they passed. I didn't add a test for the new behaviour.

The change is one extra condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeContributorsAggregator.java`. A contributor who matches no team is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. Configured teams are untouched, so they keep all their members.

A blank latest-commit date counts as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for a blank date. Nothing extra was needed there.

I did not commit.
